sql: (select 'live_order' k, strategy, status, cancel_reason, created_at::text t from live_orders order by id desc limit 5) union all (select 'bot_run', null, status, null, started_at::text from bot_runs order by id desc limit 3) union all (select 'paper', strategy, null, null, created_at::text from paper_trades order by id desc limit 8) union all (select 'shadow_quote', policy, null, null, placed_at::text from incentive_shadow_quotes order by id desc limit 3)
